tools.name: get_savings_balance
tools.description: Read-only. Retrieves the current savings account balance for a specific bank member. Returns: savings_balance (decimal). Risk: read. May instead answer with: RECORD_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_ERROR.

member_number.description: The unique identification number of the bank member.

savings_balance.description: The current balance of the member's regular savings account.

business_outcomes.PERMISSION_DENIED: The teller role may not see or change this record
business_outcomes.VALIDATION_ERROR: The app rejected an input; the message says why

tools.name: open_sub_account
tools.description: Opens a new sub-account for a member, funded from an existing share. Irreversible. Returns: confirmation_number (string). Risk: irreversible. May instead answer with: RECORD_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_ERROR, REJECTED_BY_OPERATOR.

confirmation_number.description: Confirmation number of the new sub-account

business_outcomes.PERMISSION_DENIED: The teller role may not see or change this record
business_outcomes.VALIDATION_ERROR: The app rejected an input; the message says why
business_outcomes.REJECTED_BY_OPERATOR: A person reviewed the irreversible step and rejected it; nothing was submitted
